text:
mira_am: Heads-up - Sentinel AI (acct SA-21) opened a billing dispute on INV-2026-05. They see two reserved commit lines covering the same hour after a regional capacity split. Posting the invoice snippet below.

mira_am: Invoice excerpt:
```
INV-2026-05 | SA-21 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $15,000.00
INV-2026-05 | SA-21-eu-west | Reserved Commit (alloc 70%) | $10,500.00
INV-2026-05 | SA-21-us-east | Reserved Commit (alloc 30%) | $4,500.00
INV-2026-05 | SA-21-us-east | Reserved Commit (alloc 30%) | $4,500.00  <-- duplicate line appears for 05/14 03:00-03:30
```

mira_am: Customer says they did a cross-region split for performance, but shouldn't be charged the reserved twice. Need ops to confirm and suggest credit amount.

kyle_ops: Investigating logs and allocator. Ran `alloc-inspect --acct SA-21 --period 2026-05-14 --by-window`. Early findings: during a capacity split the commit pool was cloned to two regional pools and a short window (03:00-03:30) had both pools marked as "active-commit" due to a race in pool-state reconciliation. Metering shows token counts equal to single commit, not double.

kyle_ops: excerpt from allocator log:
```
2026-05-14T02:58Z commit_pool.clone -> pool=reserved-SA-21-eu-west from reserved-SA-21
2026-05-14T03:01Z pool-state-sync retried; both regions flagged as primary for 03:00-03:30 window
2026-05-14T03:12Z reconcile fixed flags
```

kyle_ops: So billing table materialized two allocation lines for the same reserved tokens. No extra tokens consumed.

ana_billing: Proposed remediation:
- Remove duplicate reserved line: credit = $4,500 (the duplicate us-east line)
- SLA credit: customer experienced a failover spike ~30m on 05/14; SLA policy 5% per qualifying incident on committed spend -> 5% of $15,000 = $750
- Courtesy gesture for ops friction: $250

ana_billing: Provisional total credit = $5,500. I'll prepare a strike-through invoice if finance signs off.

drew_fin: I can approve provisional credits up to $5,600 to expedite response. Record FIN-7930 for tracking. Note: require infra backfill ticket and post-backfill signoff before applying final credit to accounting.

mira_am: Draft customer reply: "Thanks for flagging. We found a regional pool reconciliation race that created a duplicate reserved commit line. We've applied a provisional $5,500 credit and will send a corrected invoice after we backfill meter records. This is a one-time correction and will not change your committed profile going forward. ETA for finalized invoice: 48 business hours." ok to send?

nana_billing: Send it. I'll BCC legal on the corrected invoice template.

rachel_infra: Opening INFRA-54678 to patch pool-state-sync and run backfill for 2026-05-14. Action items:
- Fix race in pool-state reconciliation to prevent twin-primary flags.
- Re-run allocation backfill for SA-21 for May 14 window.
- Upload corrected invoice draft to S3 for finance review.

rachel_infra: ETA 36 hours. INFRA-54678: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-54678

billing-bot: Metering alert: `duplicate-reserved-allocation` SA-21 2026-05-14T03:00Z. Candidate duplicate detected and flagged for backfill.

drew_fin: FIN-7930 created and provisionally approved. Finance will wait for INFRA-54678 backfill before posting definitive credit. Include an RCA blurb in customer note when finalizing.

mira_am: Customer replied acknowledging the provisional credit and asking for the corrected invoice. I'll update once backfill completes.

rachel_infra: Backfill finished: 2026-05-15T10:05Z. Regenerated allocations show single reserved commit line; duplicate removed. Corrected invoice draft at s3://redwood-billing/corrections/SA-21/INV-2026-05-corrected.pdf

billing-bot: FIN action: credit_applied FIN-7930 amount=5500 recipient=SA-21 timestamp=2041241500

drew_fin: Confirmed backfill verification and applied credit. Finalized invoice issued and uploaded. Closing FIN-7930.

mira_am: Customer confirmed receipt and is satisfied. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
